;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Iran–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Iran]]ian [[Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] captures [[United Kingdom|British]] tanker ''Stena Impero'' and temporarily seizes British-operated and [[Liberia]]n-flagged tanker ''Mesdar'' in the [[Persian Gulf]]. [[Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs|British Foreign Secretary]] [[Jeremy Hunt]] says there will be "serious consequences" if Iran does not release the tanker. [https://www.cnn.com/middleeast/live-news/iran-british-tanker-july-2019/index.html (CNN)] [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/second-tanker-gulf-turns-sharply-190455521.html (Yahoo!)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-49053383 (BBC News)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[Iran]] denies that one of its [[unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]] was shot down by the [[United States]] on July 18, saying all of their drones "returned to their bases." [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2019/07/19/iran-disputes-trump-claim-u-s-navy-destroyed-its-drone/1775051001/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Kabul University bombing|A car bombing]] at [[Kabul University]] kills eight and injures dozens. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-afghanistan-blast/blast-at-kabul-university-kills-eight-injures-33-idUKKCN1UE09P (Reuters)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Skydive Umeå Gippsland GA8 Airvan crash]]
**The [[Gippsland GA8 Airvan]] is grounded in Australia, New Zealand and the European Union following a fatal crash on July 14. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2019/jul/21/more-than-60-victorian-made-planes-grounded-after-fatal-crash-in-sweden (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&objectid=12251302 (''New Zealand Herald'')]

;Politics and elections
